# Salih Maral — Digital Marketing Expert

Salih Maral is a freelance Digital Marketing Specialist with 15+ years of experience specializing in high-ROI pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, search engine optimization (SEO), and online reputation management. Based in Germany, serving clients worldwide in German, Turkish, and English.

## About the Expert
Salih Maral is a Google Partner certified digital marketing professional. He provides boutique, data-driven digital marketing services with transparent reporting. He works with a limited number of clients to ensure dedicated, personalized attention for each brand.

## Proven Results
- **180% Sales Increase** — E-commerce client achieved 180% sales growth within 2 months of campaign launch.
- **500+ Keywords on Page 1** — Organic SEO strategies consistently ranking 500+ keywords in Google's top positions.
- **15+ Years Experience** — Managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, and SEO campaigns since 2010.
- **5/5 Client Rating** — Consistently rated 5 out of 5 stars by clients on Google Business Profile.
- **3 Languages** — All services available in German, Turkish, and English.

## Core Services
All services are offered in German (DE), Turkish (TR), and English (EN).

- **Google Ads Management:** Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max, and Local campaigns. Maximize ROI/ROAS.
- **Meta Ads:** Facebook & Instagram advertising, advanced targeting, and creative testing.
- **TikTok Ads:** High-engagement video campaigns targeting younger demographics.
- **X (Twitter) Ads:** Real-time marketing and trending topic promotion.
- **SEO Services:** On-page, off-page, and technical search engine optimization to boost organic traffic.
- **Review Management:** Removal of unjustified or fake negative reviews on Google Maps and Trustpilot.

## FAQ
- **What does Google Ads cost?** — Costs vary by industry and competition. Average CPC ranges from €0.50 to €5. Salih Maral helps optimize your budget for maximum ROI.
- **How long until SEO shows results?** — First results typically visible in 3–6 months. Sustainable top rankings require 6–12 months of continuous optimization.
- **Which ad platforms are supported?** — Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok Ads, and X (Twitter) Ads.
- **Can negative reviews be removed?** — Yes, unjustified or fake negative reviews on Google Maps and Trustpilot can be reported and removed.
- **Do you work with international clients?** — Yes, services are available worldwide in German, Turkish, and English.
